parameters.query: UPDATE clients SET contract_signed_at = $2::timestamptz, signwell_document_id = $3, status = 'active', onboarding_stage = 'pre-day-0' WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, bedrijfsnaam, tier;

meta.notes: No outbound to a customer here — only internal DB write + Slack to founder + chain to client-onboarding. Suppression check therefore not applicable to this node, but the downstream client-onboarding workflow re-checks owner SMS/email suppression before any send.
